source_message.text:
Thank you too!

I do believe what I wrote, and I want to help you. I'll send you a bonus so that you get the full $425 tomorrow.

What we're seeking is a partner with whom we can grow together. But we are a startup, and none of the ads in the magazine are paid ads, so we have zero income until the magazine gets noticed and grows. With that said, if you feel the project compensation is too low, I completely understand. In that case, though, please send me the template you created so we can try producing the next issue ourselves.

I appreciate it!

Lena Mercer
